description: This file defines the abstract base class 'CodeBase' for barcode implementations in a PDF processing library. It includes properties for barcode text, size, direction, and anchor, as well as methods for calculating positional offsets between barcodes. It serves as a foundation for various specific barcode types, providing common functionality and enforcing implementation of code validation.

classes.name: CodeBase
classes.description: An abstract class representing the base for all barcode code types, including properties for size, text, direction, anchor, and methods for code validation and position calculation.

methods.name: CheckCode
methods.description: An abstract method to be implemented in derived classes that checks if the provided text is valid for the barcode type.

methods.name: CalcDistance
methods.description: Calculates the positional vector difference between two anchor points based on the size of the barcode.
